notes.title: Plays Everything
notes.summary: Mevedia now opens practically every video, audio and image format used in production, including iPhone HEIC photos, RAW camera files and PSDs.

items.title: Any video or audio format
items.text: If a file can't play directly (ProRes, DNxHD, MXF, AVI/DivX, WMV, AVCHD .mts/.m2ts, older QuickTime, MPEG-2, AIFF, WMA, AC3, AMR and more), Mevedia makes a playable copy in the background and plays that. You'll see "Converting this file so it can play here… 42%". Camera files that only need repackaging (like most .mts clips) are ready in about a second, at full quality. Your original file is never changed, and the copy is kept, so it opens instantly next time.

items.title: iPhone photos, RAW and PSD
items.text: HEIC/HEIF photos, RAW camera files (Canon CR2/CR3, Nikon NEF, Sony ARW, DNG, Fujifilm RAF, Olympus ORF, Panasonic RW2 and more) and Photoshop PSD/PSB files now show in the gallery and open full screen, with zoom. These work straight away, without the codec pack.

items.title: Codec pack
items.text: The pro video and audio formats, plus TIFF, need a one-time download: Settings → Media → Codec pack → Download and install (about 110 MB). It's checked against Mevedia's signature before it's installed, so a damaged or altered download is refused. You can remove it any time.

items.title: Waveforms
items.text: Audio files show a waveform above the player (with the codec pack installed).

items.title: Preview cache
items.text: Thumbnails and playable copies are kept in a cache. Settings → Media shows how much space it uses, lets you set a limit (2 to 50 GB, default 10 GB) and clear it. When it's full, the oldest items are removed first.

items.title: Faster, lighter gallery
items.text: The gallery now shows small thumbnails instead of loading every full-size photo and video. Video tiles show their length straight away, and big folders scroll much more smoothly.

items.title: More file types found when scanning
items.text: Scanning now also picks up HEIC, RAW, TIFF, MTS/M2TS, MXF, WMV, FLV, MPG, VOB, 3GP, AIFF, WMA, FLAC, Opus and project files (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, InDesign, Sketch). Press Scan once to add them.
